_doc: XBRL objective set C2: held by Eval, sealed until the run. Hashes, counts and check results only.

seed.note: With the seed, the builder at this commit and these rows reproduce the file exactly; the seed is published after the last run.

scoring_rules_fixed_before_the_run.grader: Eval's Week 8 grader, unchanged (grade_answer_blocks.grade), same precision floor and tolerance as the development set
scoring_rules_fixed_before_the_run.trailing_zeros: an answer equal to the gold value is correct even if it drops zeros printed after the decimal point; 1 questions have such a cell
scoring_rules_fixed_before_the_run.sign: strict is the primary score: the gold value carries the XBRL sign (cash paid is positive, a loss is negative). A second, labelled score ignores the sign on the cash-outflow questions only, because their cells are printed in parentheses

replaces.why: The first Set C and the first seed reached RAG by mistake on 11/25, before the run (disclosed by RAG on 11/26; RAG reports the file unopened and the seed unused). Set C was drawn again with a new seed.

index_fixed_before_this_draw: index_full 37c4eb2f1628 was recorded in RAG's pre-registration at 0ca6fb3 (2026-11-24), before this set was drawn
exclusion_note: Built with the development set as the only exclusion file: the holdout files were not in this workspace and cannot affect Set C, which contains no core company (population and exclusion counts are identical to the first build).
delivery: sent to RAG by DM as set_C2.zip; runs on index_full
inspection: Nobody has read the questions. All checks ran automatically and none flagged an item.
